reading: The order of the work as a schedule on one axis, order rather than duration, each row with its measure: measure first; a works agreement whose framework is agreed while planning and which runs alongside to the end, amended as each permission stage opens; choose suppliers; train staff; one customer record, the longest piece of work; permissions in stages (read only, then undoable actions, then changes fraud could use), each opened only after a test set passes; and running it, without end, which leads back to measuring. Arrows show that the works agreement, the trained staff and the customer record must come before the first permission. A band along the bottom: the staff stay throughout.
headline: Each step unlocks the next. The staff stay, and every permission is tested first.
note: Positions on the axis show order and dependency only, in arbitrary units: no duration or date is measured. Bar lengths say which piece of work is larger than another, not by how much.
